import.title: Import CV
import.subtitle: Import an existing CV from a file. Everything is parsed locally on this device.
import.hint: Supported files: PDF (text-based, no OCR), DOCX, and a single CV/cover letter JSON. Workspace bundles are imported directly.

import.emptySection: No entries detected in this section.
import.unmappedHint: These lines could not be assigned automatically. Choose a section, then add each line as a new entry or append it to an existing entry.
import.warningEmptyText: No readable text was found in this file. It may be an image-only scan, which is not supported without OCR.
